verdict.rationale: UKVI's own online services let you access your immigration status through eVisas. A processing-times service tells applicants when they can expect a decision. Neither is evidenced as a live tracker of an in-progress application's status; the processing-time tool gives an expected decision date, not your case's actual status. Missing for 10: a documented real-time lookup of a pending application or case status, explicit coverage of founder-route applications, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: eVisas: access and use your online immigration status
use the online service to check your visa processing time. This will tell you when you can expect a decision.
